item.title: EFSEC (state energy siting council): Comment on the Cascade Renewable Transmission line planned for the bed of the Columbia River
item.description: EFSEC, the state's energy siting council, scheduled three hearings on the proposed Cascade Renewable Transmission line, one in each county it would cross: Washougal on November 16, Stevenson on November 17 and White Salmon on November 18. The Council asks whether the project fit local land-use plans and zoning when it applied, and takes comment on any other part of the project too. The line would run about 40 miles through Clark, Skamania and Klickitat counties, mostly in the bed of the river.
